from z3 import *
import time

# Parameters
num_players = 30
num_groups = 10
group_size = 3
num_weeks = 8

# Variables: group[w][p] = group number (0-9) for player p in week w
group = [[Int(f'g_{w}_{p}') for p in range(num_players)] for w in range(num_weeks)]

s = Solver()

# Domain constraints: each player is in a group 0-9
for w in range(num_weeks):
    for p in range(num_players):
        s.add(group[w][p] >= 0, group[w][p] < num_groups)

# Partition constraint: each group has exactly 3 players
for w in range(num_weeks):
    for g in range(num_groups):
        s.add(Sum([If(group[w][p] == g, 1, 0) for p in range(num_players)]) == group_size)

# No pair constraint: no two players are in the same group more than once
for p1 in range(num_players):
    for p2 in range(p1+1, num_players):
        for w1 in range(num_weeks):
            for w2 in range(w1+1, num_weeks):
                s.add(Not(And(group[w1][p1] == group[w1][p2], group[w2][p1] == group[w2][p2])))

# Symmetry breaking: fix week 0
for g in range(num_groups):
    for i in range(group_size):
        s.add(group[0][g*group_size + i] == g)

# Fix player 0 to group 0 in all weeks
for w in range(1, num_weeks):
    s.add(group[w][0] == 0)

print(f"Number of assertions: {len(s.assertions())}")
print("Solving...")
start = time.time()
result = s.check()
print(f"Result: {result}")
print(f"Time: {time.time() - start:.2f}s")
